time_window._comment_mode: Use ONE of the two modes below. Comment out (or delete) the one you don't want.

date_range._comment: Format: DD-MM-YYYY. Remove this block (or set to null) when using last_hours.

databases._comment: Enable the sources you want to query.

cvss._comment_min_score: Minimum numeric CVSS score (0.0 – 10.0). Set to null to use severity_filter instead.
cvss._comment_severity: Used only when min_score is null. Comma-separated list from: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
